notes: How the numbers read: (1) All figures are development numbers on seen sources, and the model was selected on field_dev; E4's held-out-source runs scored far lower, so the 0.885 threshold, the 5% confident error and the gate rates may not hold on new photo sources. (2) Coverage is 0.497, just under the 0.5 target on the scoring half, because the threshold was fitted on the other half. (3) The chosen gate's confidence threshold is only 0.091, so it is effectively an entropy gate; it gains 15 of 25 COCO rejections over confidence alone at the cost of 7 extra plant rejections. (4) Not-plant means COCO images without potted plants; green non-plants are only partly caught (2 of 18 with over 50% green accepted). (5) Plant rejection for the chosen gate is 3.7% on the scoring half, and the 22 low-green plant photos are all accepted. (6) decide can return an empty top_k when no class exceeds 10%, and T5.2 must handle that. (7) cv2 is not installed, so green_ratio equality with OpenCV was judged by reading, not by pixel diff. (8) The E5 tracked files results/e5/*.jsonl and results/runs/E5-* contain per-image probabilities keyed by PlantDoc and COCO paths; these are model outputs, not images, and match what E4 already tracks, but you asked that nothing derived from them be tracked, so decide if that rule covers model outputs. (9) docs/DECISIONS.md entry for T4.2 does not record why num_workers went to 0 (it says the reason is not recorded), though the commit message and log give it.
